note: No 'Figure 9.x' caption is printed -- this is an unnumbered displayed reaction scheme: benzenesulphonyl chloride (drawn benzene ring with SO2Cl) + H-N(H)-C2H5 -> the sulphonamide + HCl. Labels are listed structure by structure in the direction the reaction reads (left reactant, then the amine, then the product, then HCl), which for this scheme is also roughly left-to-right; within each structure the order is the atom label above the S, then the main chain, then the label below. Structure lost by the flat list: `labels` cannot show which O/S/N/H belongs to which drawn structure, nor the ring skeletons, the double bonds (S=O) or the reaction arrow. The two benzene rings carry no printed label at all. The printed '+' signs joining species are operators, not labels, and are omitted. Printed subscripts are written inline ('C2H5' for C₂H₅); the italic N in 'N-Ethylbenzenesulphonamide' is a locant and its italics are not represented. target_box_in_crop runs from the text line 'The reaction of benzenesulphonyl chloride with primary amine / yields N-ethylbenzenesulphonyl amide.' down through the scheme, clipping the bottom H atoms and the compound name; those two prose lines belong to the preceding block and are excluded, while the clipped labels at the very bottom of the artwork are included since they are part of this figure.
